metricDefinitions.mean_signed_margin_error_pp: Equal-race mean of joint native margin minus frozen predicted mean margin.
metricDefinitions.mean_absolute_margin_error_pp: Equal-race mean absolute difference between joint native margin and frozen predicted mean margin.
metricDefinitions.interval_90_coverage_count: Count of joint native margins inside inclusive saved forecast5th/95th percentile bounds.
metricDefinitions.modal_pair_winner_miss_count: Count of native principal-pair winners differing from the marginal modal principal; exact0.5 probability selects first candidate explicitly.

raceMarginProbabilityDefinitions.margin: M = 100*(V_first-V_second)/(V_first+V_second) = 200*first_share-100, under each row's declared principal-pair rule proxy.
raceMarginProbabilityDefinitions.close_margin_probability_2pp: Uniform fraction of retained joint rows with abs(M) <= 2; both boundaries inclusive.
raceMarginProbabilityDefinitions.first_decisive_margin_probability_10pp: Uniform fraction of retained joint rows with M >= 10; boundary inclusive.
raceMarginProbabilityDefinitions.second_decisive_margin_probability_10pp: Uniform fraction of retained joint rows with M <= -10; boundary inclusive.
raceMarginProbabilityDefinitions.candidate_identity: First/second refer to the named candidate IDs in each cohort row. An independent first candidate is not recoded Democratic.
raceMarginProbabilityDefinitions.partition: The three events are mutually exclusive but not exhaustive. Margins between 2 and 10 points in either direction belong to none of them.

qualifications: Model-implied reference only; not an empirical error estimate, calibrated grading band, or proof of prediction quality.
Signed error is centered and marginal interval coverage is nominal by construction; their joint spread reflects preserved model dependence.
Conditional principal-pair shares and winner proxies are not all-candidate outcomes. Actual-result identity/denominator/rule masks must be reviewed before scoring.
All35 native targets are included in this diagnostic cohort; an actual-results subset requires a separately pinned fixed cohort and recomputation from the same joint rows.
This is a dated forecast edition, not the final evaluation lock. No House/Senate cross-chamber coupling or caucus aggregation is implied.
No A–F grade thresholds are selected here.
Close and decisive probabilities are model-implied retained-draw fractions, not observed accuracy, A-F grades or a new tossup classification rule.
These probabilities retain Monte Carlo uncertainty and inherit model limitations. Zero retained occurrences do not establish an impossible outcome.
Original v1 cohort fields, distributions, chain/draw ordering and joint diagnostic array bytes are unchanged; joint_rows intentionally points to the preserved v1 archive.
